stanza: And the first thing that you want
Will be the last thing you ever need

blindly.songTitle: Today I Was an Evil One
stanza: The day was spent walking about

kindly.line: Loud, loutish lover, treat her kindly
stanza: The soil falling over my head
You see, the sea wants to take me, the knife wants to slit me
Do you think you can help me?
Loud, loutish lover, treat her kindly
Though she needs you more than she loves you

kindly.linePrev: Had your fam saying, "Please, make me a dub"
kindly.lineNext: Where he been behind the mask, who can't find me?
